script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Uranus is firing a conjunction directly into your 10th House of Career, while Saturn squares your natal Venus in the 7th House of Partnerships. This air sign is feeling the pressure to make bold professional moves, but relationship tensions are building underneath. If you're single, the 5th House spotlight is revealing a creative confidence that magnetizes the kind of partner you've been avoiding. In love, watch for an older authority figure crossing your path in an unexpected way. In finances, the 2nd House income sector is catching a powerful alignment with Jupiter, signaling a bonus or windfall coming before month's end. Avoid making impulsive romantic decisions before the 28th, because the Mercury retrograde shadow is actively clouding your judgment. Follow for tomorrow's reading and let the cosmos guide your week.
